summary: deb822_repository options for insecure/weak repositories, architectures, by-hash index fetching, date checks, components, enabling the source, include/exclude package filters (apt 3.1+), and InRelease path.
questions: How do I restrict a repo to amd64 only?
How do I disable a deb822 repo without removing it?
Can I only allow certain packages from a repository?
How do I allow an insecure apt repository?
What are components in a deb822 repo?

answer_card.title: deb822_repository parameters (part 1)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `architectures`: e.g. `[amd64]`
- `components`: sections like `main`, `contrib`
- `enabled`: enable/disable the source
- `include` / `exclude` (2.21+, apt ≥ 3.1): which packages to use/skip; mutually exclusive
- `allow_insecure`, `allow_weak`, `allow_downgrade_to_insecure`
- `by_hash`, `check_date`, `check_valid_until`, `date_max_future`, `inrelease_path`
